svg.title: One synaptic retrieval, traced
svg.desc: The activation trace of the quick-start question on the fictional starter vault. Three full-text hits are the seeds (activation 1.00, 1.00 and 0.96). One hop along explicit links reaches eight notes; Watering Schedule v2 (activation 0.154, reached from three seeds) and Drip Irrigation Basics (0.040) were delivered in the packet; the other six were not.
